# Astan Technologies
> Astan Technologies identifies costly operational bottlenecks in growing businesses and designs and delivers the technology solution required to remove them — whether that means software, AI, automation, integration, third-party systems or supporting technology.

## About
Astan is a technology and engineering company. The core operating model is: Pain → Validated Business Problem → Commercial Opportunity → Solution Architecture → Build / Buy / Automate / Integrate / Source → Astan-led Delivery.

Astan does not have a preferred technology. The capability set spans operations and enterprise systems, integration and payments, AI and automation, digital products, and specialized technology including Bitcoin and blockchain.

## How Astan Works
1. Diagnose: Study how operations actually work — workflows, tools, handoffs, workarounds
2. Validate: Confirm the business problem is real, measurable, and worth solving
3. Architect: Design the solution architecture — what to build, buy, automate, integrate, or source
4. Compose: Assemble the right combination of custom software, platforms, AI, automation, and integrations
5. Deliver: Lead technical delivery from development through launch, training, and handoff
6. Improve: Monitor performance, gather feedback, and refine as operations evolve

## Solution Composition
- BUILD: Custom systems when bespoke software is justified
- BUY: Existing products when rebuilding would add little value
- AUTOMATE: AI/workflow automation where repetitive work can be removed
- INTEGRATE: Connect systems that currently operate in silos
- SOURCE: Identify required supporting technology where the complete solution has physical or third-party dependencies
- HYBRID: Combine these where necessary
